scope: All normalized fund report positions, all available actual report dates2008-2026; end-of-report estimated portfolio units and prior-report changes. No new H1/H2/H3 regression.
quote_policy: One canonical quote per ISIN and report date; positive finite existing RUB CLOSE at/before actual date, maximum7calendar days; primaryboard preferred if unambiguous, then most recent/tradingvalue/SECID/board; conflicting per-unit prices per same instrument/board/day rejected. Shares price perunit; bonds CLOSE*historical_RUB_FACEVALUE/100, primary clean-price estimate.
units: amount_thousand_rub*1000/price_RUB_per_security; quantity_est FLOAT with no integer rounding; observed unit count remains unavailable. market VOLUME and source_lots are never fund quantities.
missing: No valid price/FX/nominal/identifier -> quantity unavailable, not zero. Cash/unidentified residuals remain monetary positions. No inferred count for negative/partial/missing monetary amount.
previous: Use previous actual fund report from sealed all_true_intervals. Absent prior position counts as zero only if opening_full_portfolio is true and instrument is countable. First/missing/incomplete prior positions remain unavailable. Relative change undefined at zero previous base; no infinity or arbitrary replacement.
shares: Reported normalized gross-asset weight, not NAV share: absolute share delta in percentagepoints and relative share delta100*(w1/w0-1).
workbook: One downloadable XLSX, Russian labels, summary of fund periods and complete chronological data split byyear to respect Excel row limit. All source positions retained, no row sample as final file; static scientific snapshot, calculation inputs and status shown. Filters/frozen headers/identifiers, meaningful numeric formats and documented unavailable values.
execution: Numeric processing on research-host; workbook authoring separate after excel_manifest.ready; only requested final derived workbook and small preview/metadata mirrored toMac. Protected inputs/old outputs/Gemma unchanged.
authoring_runtime: Bundled WindowsNode/artifact-tool present; bounded resource use, no parallel with dataset processing. If actual full-scale artifact-tool error/OOM, preserve prepared data and record unavailable-capability fallback rather than repeat data extraction.
